decision.reason: Current cross-boundary shapes are already governed by SongChart's data contract and typed domain/provider owners, while a broad public API resource/DTO surface has not yet emerged. Adopting Laravel Data now would add package glue before there is enough duplicated DTO/request/resource transformation surface to retire.
revisit_when: the same cross-boundary shape is maintained independently in request validation, DTOs, resources and TypeScript
schema/TypeScript generation can replace duplicate manually maintained contracts
